description: Generate the provider authorization URL that starts connecting an integration (providers: shopify — requires shopUrl, amazon, qbo, xero, zoho_books, etsy). IMPORTANT: you cannot complete the connection yourself — hand the returned URL to a human Spark admin to open in their browser, then poll get_integration_status until connected. No secrets or tokens ever pass through this tool. Requires an operator (unpinned) org token.

provider.description: shopify | amazon | qbo | xero | zoho_books | etsy

shopUrl.description: Shopify only (required there): the myshopify.com store domain, e.g. 'my-store.myshopify.com'.

name: start_integration_connect
title: Connect Integration
